title: Norm Technology Absolutely Feature Complete
description: Create the norm technology as headless Rust crates for end-to-end norm compliance computation: shared norm_core plus one family crate per listed path (norm/din/v/18599, norm/din/4108, norm/din/en/16798, norm/en/1990-1999), each implementing every part of that family with German national annex where applicable.
summary: Round-2 remediation: the prior closure was premature — an audit found the completeness gate (real formulas, clause tables, DE-NA divergence, numeric worked-example test, evaluate() coverage per part) unmet across most crates. Fixed all of it. norm_core: added QuantityKind::Acceleration. Introduced a uniform AnnexParams (EN-recommended vs DE-NA) pattern across every Eurocode crate, replacing hardcoded gamma/alpha constants with genuine annex-branching NDPs (EN 1990 seismic 6.12b + psi divergence, EN 1991 snow/wind zone vs user-value + bridge alpha_Q, EN 1992 alpha_cc 1.0/0.85, EN 1993 gamma_M1 1.0/1.1, EN 1995 k_cr 0.67 vs min(1.0,2.5/f_v,k) fixing a prior no-op alias, EN 1996 gamma_M class table vs flat 1.5, EN 1997 DA2*/DA2, EN 1998 EN Type1/2 spectrum vs DE zone model, EN 1994/EN 1999/DIN crates documented-equal where the standard has no real NDP split). Restructured part modules to match the real published standard structure and wired every part into evaluate()/check_full_*: EN 1993 (16 parts, fixed scrambled clause content across 7 modules including a net-tension gamma_M2 bug and a dimensionally-wrong bolt-bearing formula), EN 1999 (deleted fabricated part_1_6, rewrote part_1_4/1_5 to real cold-formed-sheeting/shell scope), EN 1992 (part_4 renamed from mislabeled 'precast' to real fastenings scope; wired dead fire/bridge/liquid-retaining parts), EN 1996 (part_2/part_3 rewritten from wrong content), EN 1997 (part_1/part_2 content swapped to match the real classic-generation scope), EN 1998 (parts 3-6 fully reshuffled to real scope, dam content deleted as out-of-scope), DIN EN 16798 (restructured 17 modules to the 9 real normative parts, TRs absorbed), DIN 4108 (part_1 honestly rewritten as withdrawn-part plausibility validation, added missing part_10 and Beiblatt 2), DIN V 18599 (part_1 rewritten as real primary-energy aggregation). Fixed norm/plugin/rs/lib.rs's no-op 'evaluate' view action (was discarding a computed NormHost) to emit a real SetDocument commit. Rewrote part-checklist.md against the real part maps with documented scope decisions (DIN crates have no EN/DE annex split; EN 1997 models the classic generation only; EN 1998 excludes dams). Verified: 218/218 tests pass across all 14 headless crates plus norm-plugin (isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR), up from 130 at the prior premature closure.
